annotation.authors_or_issuer: Krarup, B.; Lindner, F.; Krivic, S.; Long, D.
key_provisions_or_claims: Formalises moral permissibility of robot plans under ethical principles such as do-no-harm in a planning formalism.
Generates non-contrastive and contrastive explanations of plan ethics from user questions.
Uses compilations that constrain planning models to satisfy chosen ethical principles.
User study finds both explanation types help users understand the robot's moral reasoning; contrastive more effective in some cases.
annotation.summary_en: Technical paper presenting a system that lets users ask contrastive questions about the ethics of a robot's action plans and receive automatically generated explanations based on ethical principles like do-no-harm. A user study shows the explanations improve understanding of the robot's moral reasoning.
annotation.title_clean: Understanding a Robot's Guiding Ethical Principles via Automatically Generated Explanations
annotation.title_en: Understanding a Robot's Guiding Ethical Principles via Automatically Generated Explanations
